about.draft: Legal document pending approval. The final document will be published here before release. Until then, this is only a plain-language summary, not a legal document.
about.privacyBody: PrimeMe AI stores your profile, plans, food and activity logs, optional weight entries and optional photos on your device. If you create an account, this data is also stored in our cloud database so you can restore it and use it on other devices; photos are kept in private storage that only your account can access. If you use AI features (Pro), the photo or message and, only if you allow it, a short summary of your recent plans and logs are processed by our server and an AI provider to answer that request; they are not kept afterwards except the results you save. Subscriptions are handled by Apple or Google and our subscription provider, RevenueCat. We don't sell your data or use it for advertising. You can export or delete your data, and delete your account, at any time in the app.
about.termsBody: PrimeMe AI supports healthy routines and is not a medical device or a substitute for professional advice. Nutrition values and AI results are estimates. Workout entries are self-reported. The app is intended for adults aged 18 and over. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your App Store or Google Play account settings.
about.medical: PrimeMe AI doesn't provide medical advice. If you have a health condition, are pregnant, or are unsure what's right for you, please talk to a healthcare professional.
about.help: Log your meals in Kitchen and finish your food diary. Log a workout or a rest day in Gym. When both are done, your day is complete. Planning the next day is optional.
about.noContact: A support contact will be added before release.
about.licensesIntro: PrimeMe AI uses these third-party works. The 3D bodies were converted and given a custom look for the app.
